newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN refugee agency sends team to Kisangani.
newsitem.headline: UN refugee agency sends team to Kisangani.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR has welcomed the decision by Zairean insurgents to call a ceasefire around the just-captured city of Kisangani to allow in aid for refugees caught up in the fighting.
UNHCR spokeswoman Pam O'Toole said several U.N. agencies were taking advantage of the ceasefire to send a team to Kisangani on Wednesday to assess the situation and the aid needs there.
The team was travelling from Goma, near Zaire's border with Rwanda, which is presently the headquarters of insurgent leader Laurent Kabila. His forces now control large swathes of the country.
"We want to find ways of bringing in large quantities of desperately needed humanitarian assistance for refugees in the region," O'Toole said.
Tens of thousands of Rwandan Hutus, who fled their country after the 1994 massacres of Tutsis and moderate Hutus, have been fleeing before the advance of the rebels, many of whom are Tutsis.
